hash_policy: source_record_sha256 binds authored ledger metadata; no raw-page checksum claim

review_levels.page_text_and_browser_image: page text plus one selected publicly published image visually inspected in browser
review_levels.search_excerpt: search-returned excerpt inspected; complete page and embedded image not verified
review_levels.search_indexed_post_text: substantial indexed self-authored post text inspected; direct page open failed

sources.title: FanimeCon 2026 Cosplay Gatherings Listing
factual_notes: Games, anime, Vocaloid/UTAU, Project Sekai and Hololive have named gathering slots.
sources.claim_limits: Scheduled gatherings establish programming; participant counts and costume-version frequencies are absent.

sources.title: Anime Expo: Cosplay Gatherings help
factual_notes: Gatherings are attendee-organized meetings for costumes sharing a series or game.
sources.claim_limits: The definition is not an attendance survey.

sources.title: World Cosplay Championship 2025 results
factual_notes: The results identify teams, works, characters and distinct craft/performance awards.
sources.claim_limits: Competition selection is not a sample of all event attendees.

sources.title: Comic-Con Masquerade page, 2025 winners section
factual_notes: The inspected page includes a 2025 winners section with The Wiz and Bumblebee.
sources.claim_limits: The URL/header says 2026; do not relabel the embedded 2025 winners as 2026 results.

sources.title: WonderCon Masquerade, 2025 winners section
factual_notes: The excerpt includes original Night Sisters and a Super Sailor Jupiter entry.
sources.claim_limits: Page heading and result year differ; use the explicit 2025 section only.

sources.title: Dragon Con Masquerade Winners 2025
factual_notes: Listed entries span KPop Demon Hunters, Optimus Prime, Totoro and Medusa.
sources.claim_limits: Award entries cannot establish the frequency of these costumes on the convention floor.

sources.title: Pyrkon: winners of recent Masquerades
factual_notes: The 2025 entry identifies Neve Gallus and Lucanis Dellamorte from Dragon Age: The Veilguard.
sources.claim_limits: Selected winners provide repertoire examples, not a popularity ranking.

sources.title: CONvergence 2025 Masquerade
factual_notes: The program includes a Rococo Hatsune Miku interpretation.
sources.claim_limits: An interpreted design should retain both its character and historical-style dimensions.

sources.title: G-STAR: previous event results
factual_notes: The archive includes the 2025 game cosplay awards.
sources.claim_limits: The retrieved excerpt does not supply wearer counts or a character-frequency table.

sources.title: G-STAR 2025 cosplay scene report
factual_notes: The report names StarCraft Zealot and Helldivers costumes outside BEXCO.
sources.claim_limits: A reporter-selected scene confirms examples, not their share of all costumes.

sources.title: C105 selected cosplay photo report
factual_notes: The selected gallery names NIKKE, Genshin Impact, Zenless Zone Zero, Blue Archive and VTuber cosplay.
sources.claim_limits: C105 occurred in December 2024; the article was published in January 2025. A curated gallery has no attendance denominator.

sources.title: Enako first major photobook, publisher catalog
factual_notes: The book combines licensed manga-character cosplay with an original design by Masakazu Katsura.
sources.claim_limits: This is a 2019 publishing case, not evidence of 2026 event popularity.

sources.title: NIKKE × Kyoto collaboration event report with Iori Moe
sources.publisher: Proxima Beta Pte. Ltd. via PR TIMES
factual_notes: Iori Moe appeared as Anis: Star in a bespoke Kyo-Yuzen kimono collaboration outfit.
sources.claim_limits: Keep the collaboration version separate from the character's standard game outfit and mascot representation.

sources.title: NIKKE Tokyo Game Show 2022 booth announcement
sources.publisher: Level Infinite / Proxima Beta via PR TIMES
factual_notes: The announcement assigns Marian to Iori Moe and Neon to Kokoro Shinozaki.
sources.claim_limits: An announced appearance is not, by itself, verified attendance or a visual costume inspection.

sources.title: RZCOS C107 and Guangzhou BrownDust2 field report
factual_notes: C107 assignments include 나리땽: 쉐도우바니 에레니르 and 시루: 프로즌 퀸 빌헬미나.
The Guangzhou report names 나리땽: 데이드림 바니 모르페아 and 야살: 프로즌 퀸 빌헬미나.
sources.claim_limits: Team self-report is explicit about assignments; embedded photos were not inspected here. Preserve the source's Korean spellings for matching.

sources.title: Spiral Cats interview: LoL cosplay project
factual_notes: The interview discusses Arcade Ahri, Riven and Gnar in a team project.
sources.claim_limits: This older project illustrates skin versions and character types; it does not establish current frequency.

sources.title: NIKKE AGF 2025 booth announcement
factual_notes: The announcement plans a professional cosplay runway for AGF 2025.
sources.claim_limits: Plans and actual participation are separate statuses.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay costume project archive
factual_notes: Projects cover game-character clothing, armor and film/game costumes.
sources.claim_limits: A portfolio is selected output; it cannot estimate either all cosplay or the creator's complete work history.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay: Yelan
factual_notes: The maker describes asymmetric construction, a separate bow build and collaboration on wig styling.
sources.claim_limits: The inspected front/back composite supports visible asymmetry; hidden attachment methods require the maker record.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay: Yelan making article
factual_notes: The article lists multiple textile types and describes a Gamescom 2023 costume project.
sources.claim_limits: The 2025 publication date is not the project's event date.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay: Iden Versio
factual_notes: The maker reports EVA foam helmet/armor/props paired with a cotton suit for an EA/Lucasfilm commission.
sources.claim_limits: Metal-like finish does not establish metal composition, ballistic protection or a functioning weapon.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay: Demonic Brigitte
factual_notes: The record identifies an Overwatch/Diablo crossover design with foam construction and LEDs.
sources.claim_limits: The published image is edited; it cannot prove every photographed fire/glow effect is produced by the physical costume.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay: Demonic Shield
factual_notes: The shield build uses foam, painting and programmed lighting effects.
sources.claim_limits: Electrical operation is maker-reported; a photograph can establish only appearance.

sources.title: Kamui Cosplay: an accessible hobby
factual_notes: The maker describes a range from paper/fabric and thermoplastics to EVA foam and 3D printing.
sources.claim_limits: No material or tool is compulsory for every cosplay.

sources.title: Kinpatsu: Jinx Arcane tutorials and patterns
factual_notes: The tutorial covers sewing, wig styling, belts, boots and tattoo templates for the Arcane version.
sources.claim_limits: Catalog coverage does not demonstrate every technique in an inspected finished image.

sources.title: Kinpatsu: Jinx League of Legends props
factual_notes: The prop tutorial describes foam finishing and illuminated details.
sources.claim_limits: Keep this League of Legends prop version distinct from the Arcane costume tutorial.

sources.title: Kinpatsu: K/DA Ahri
factual_notes: The tutorial describes a lightweight transparent tail with a harness, ears and styled wig.
sources.claim_limits: The source supports one K/DA interpretation, not a rule that every Ahri tail is transparent.

sources.title: Kinpatsu: Ears and Tails for Cosplay
factual_notes: The book distinguishes shaped/poseable ears, fur treatment and tail attachment methods.
sources.claim_limits: Costume appendages are made objects; they do not establish wearer anatomy or species.

sources.title: Kinpatsu: Witch Hat Patterns
factual_notes: Multiple witch-hat variants are offered, including foam-based construction.
sources.claim_limits: A witch label alone does not specify brim width, cone curvature or construction.

sources.title: Yaya Han: Rumi
factual_notes: The maker explicitly describes a hanbok-inspired stage interpretation with layered textiles, applied motifs and lighting.
sources.claim_limits: Traditional clothing, a screen design and a stage reinterpretation have separate contracts. Hidden corsetry/electronics are maker-reported.

sources.title: Yaya Han: Carmilla
factual_notes: The Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust costume uses red velvet and contrasting gold fabric.
sources.claim_limits: These colors/materials belong to this version, not to every vampire costume.

sources.title: Yaya Han: Misty May
factual_notes: The Otaku no Video project combines a bodysuit, cropped vest and a feathered tail.
sources.claim_limits: A bunny-themed costume does not imply a specific real body, material or sexual scene.

sources.title: Yaya Han: Jessica Rabbit
factual_notes: The maker describes internal corsetry and hair styling for the character silhouette.
sources.claim_limits: The result is costume construction; it is not a measurement or claim about the wearer's natural body.

sources.title: Yaya Han: Lulu
factual_notes: The Final Fantasy X build combines corsetry, belt construction, fur trim and decorative work.
sources.claim_limits: The layered construction should not be collapsed into a single generic black dress.

sources.title: V&A Costume collection
factual_notes: Costume spans theater, opera, dance, popular music, cabaret and circus.
sources.claim_limits: A broad collecting category does not define every visual feature of each costume family.

sources.title: The Museum at FIT: Uniformity
factual_notes: The exhibition connects military, school, work and sports uniforms to fashion, including historical service and flight clothing.
sources.claim_limits: Historical uniform elements do not establish modern duty requirements or the wearer's actual occupation.

sources.title: The Museum at FIT: Gothic Dark Glamour
factual_notes: Gothic is a fashion/aesthetic domain with several imaginative and historical references.
sources.claim_limits: It is not synonymous with vampire cosplay, Lolita fashion or exclusively black fabric.

sources.title: The Museum at FIT: Exposed, a History of Lingerie
factual_notes: The exhibition distinguishes structured corsets and softer undergarments and their relation to outer fashion.
sources.claim_limits: A visible clothing construction does not supply a sexual activity or context.

sources.title: FIT Fashion History Timeline: Panniers
factual_notes: Panniers shape lateral skirt width while the front/back can remain comparatively flat.
sources.claim_limits: Skirt outline alone may not identify the hidden support material.

sources.title: FIT Fashion History Timeline: Bustle
factual_notes: A bustle supports volume behind the body.
sources.claim_limits: Posterior volume and lateral pannier width are different relations.

sources.title: Theatrecrafts costume glossary
factual_notes: The glossary distinguishes bodice/corset terms and covers aging costumes and quick-change layering.
sources.claim_limits: Terminology supplies construction concepts, not a particular character's canonical design.

sources.title: V&A: Kimono
factual_notes: Kimono discussion includes wrapped clothing and obi-related styling.
sources.claim_limits: Specific era, sleeve, closure and wearing contexts require variant-level evidence.

sources.title: V&A: Hanbok, traditional Korean dress
factual_notes: Hanbok is a broad clothing tradition with components including jeogori and chima.
sources.claim_limits: A contemporary stage costume should not overwrite historical/traditional forms.

sources.title: V&A: Conserving a ballet tutu
factual_notes: The conservation example identifies layered tulle in a ballet tutu.
sources.claim_limits: One conserved tutu does not establish a single universal length or disk shape.

sources.title: V&A: The story of pantomime
factual_notes: Harlequin is described with a mask and patched clothing.
sources.claim_limits: Harlequin, Pierrot and a generic clown should retain separate variant labels.

sources.title: World of WearableArt 2025 People's Choice: The Autumn King
factual_notes: Catherine Anderton's wearable-art design combines several textile and foam materials.
sources.claim_limits: Wearable sculpture is a representation mode; it need not depict a licensed character.

sources.title: World of WearableArt: Hidden Layers
factual_notes: Anna Weszelovszky's Hidden Layers is described as a transforming garment.
sources.claim_limits: A still image does not verify the complete transformation sequence.

sources.title: UNESCO: Kebaya knowledge, skills, traditions and practices
factual_notes: Kebaya includes front-opening tops, often embroidery and fasteners, across several Southeast Asian communities.
sources.claim_limits: Do not flatten regional variants into one national costume or infer wearer identity.

sources.title: Roots: Cheongsam tailoring
factual_notes: The reference discusses standing collars, diagonal openings and knotted fasteners.
sources.claim_limits: Do not force one fitted modern silhouette onto every qipao/cheongsam period.

sources.title: The Met: Chasuble, object 158329
factual_notes: This mid-nineteenth-century chasuble uses shaped appliquéd patches to create a textile illusion.
sources.claim_limits: A single object does not define all clergy, religious communities or vestments.

sources.title: The Met: The Chiton, Peplos, and Himation in Modern Dress
factual_notes: The essay distinguishes structural garment types and warns that ancient clothing terminology and evidence vary.
sources.claim_limits: A modern draped costume is not direct proof of historically exact ancient dress.

sources.title: The Met: Kaftan, object 454043
factual_notes: An Ottoman kaftan fragment preserves large woven motifs on silk.
sources.claim_limits: A fragment provides textile/object evidence, not a complete worn silhouette.

sources.title: V&A: A celebration of carnival in seven objects
factual_notes: The objects include a Keith Khan stilt-walker costume worn at Preston Carnival in 1988.
sources.claim_limits: Carnival has specific local histories; do not treat it as a single generic feathered showgirl design.
